spans.text: They said: "Glory to Thee, of knowledge We have none, save what Thou Hast taught us: In truth it is Thou Who art perfect in knowledge and wisdom."

folded.id: thou place|therein|one who will make mischief therein and shed blood?- whilst we do celebrate thy praises and glorify thy holy (name)?"
folded.subject: Thou place
folded.object: one who will make mischief therein and shed blood?- whilst we do celebrate Thy praises and glorify Thy holy (name)?"

spans.text: They said: "Wilt Thou place therein one who will make mischief therein and shed blood?- whilst we do celebrate Thy praises and glorify Thy holy (name)?"

folded.id: thy lord|said|to the angels: "i will create a vicegerent on earth
folded.subject: thy Lord
folded.object: to the angels: "I will create a vicegerent on earth

spans.text: Behold, thy Lord said to the angels: "I will create a vicegerent on earth."
How can ye reject the faith in Allah?- seeing that ye were without life, and He gave you life; then will He cause you to die, and will again bring you to life; and again to Him will ye return.
When it is said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth," they say: "Why, we only Want to make peace!"

folded.id: we|said|to the angels: "bow down to adam" and they bowed down
folded.subject: We
folded.object: to the angels: "Bow down to Adam" and they bowed down

spans.text: And behold, We said to the angels: "Bow down to Adam" and they bowed down.

By it He causes many to stray, and many He leads into the right path; but He causes not to stray, except those who forsake (the path),- Those who break Allah's Covenant after it is ratified, and who sunder what Allah Has ordered to be joined, and do mischief on earth: These cause loss (only) to themselves.

folded.id: when it|is|said to them: "make not mischief on the earth
folded.subject: When it
folded.object: said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth

spans.text: When it is said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth," they say: "Why, we only Want to make peace!"
When it is said to them: "Believe as the others believe:" They say: "Shall we believe as the fools believe?"

folded.id: which|is|prepared for those who reject faith
folded.subject: which
folded.object: prepared for those who reject Faith

spans.text: But if ye cannot- and of a surety ye cannot- then fear the Fire whose fuel is men and stones,- which is prepared for those who reject Faith.

Adore your Guardian-Lord, who created you and those who came before you, that ye may have the chance to learn righteousness; Who has made the earth your couch, and the heavens your canopy; and sent down rain from the heavens; and brought forth therewith Fruits for your sustenance; then set not up rivals unto Allah when ye know (the truth).
But if ye cannot- and of a surety ye cannot- then fear the Fire whose fuel is men and stones,- which is prepared for those who reject Faith.
